description: Decode strict standard Base64 into UTF-8 text. Missing or null input uses empty text; malformed Base64 fails before output, and encoded input or decoded results longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: encoded
inputs.description: Strict standard Base64 text to decode as UTF-8. Missing or null input uses empty text; malformed Base64 or input longer than 65536 characters fails before output.

outputs.name: decoded
outputs.description: UTF-8 text decoded from the Base64 input. Results longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

description: Decode URL form text as UTF-8. Missing or null input uses empty text; plus signs become spaces, malformed percent escapes fail before output, and encoded input or decoded results longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

inputs.name: encoded
inputs.description: URL form text to decode as UTF-8. Plus signs become spaces; malformed percent escapes or input longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

outputs.name: decoded
outputs.description: UTF-8 text decoded with URL form semantics. Results longer than 65536 characters fail before output.

description: Wrap text into lines using Unicode whitespace separation. Whitespace collapses between words, overlong words remain unsplit, text and results are limited to 65536 characters, and width must be a finite whole number from 1 through 65536; invalid values fail before output.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: Text to wrap. Unicode whitespace separates words and collapses between them; input longer than 65536 characters fails before output.

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Maximum whole-number line width. Missing or null input uses 80; the value must be finite and from 1 through 65536, and invalid values fail before output.

outputs.name: wrapped_lines_list
outputs.description: Wrapped lines in order. Whitespace is collapsed, overlong words are not split, and each produced line is limited to 65536 characters.

description: Serialize a value as JSON text. Missing or null input produces the JSON literal null.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: Value to serialize as JSON. Missing or null input produces the JSON literal null.

outputs.name: json
outputs.description: JSON text representing the input value.

description: Parse JSON text as a string, list, or map. Missing or null JSON input uses empty text, and type_name defaults to string.

inputs.name: json
inputs.description: JSON text to parse. Missing or null input uses empty text.

inputs.name: type_name
inputs.description: Target type name. Use string, list, or map; missing or null input uses string.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: The parsed string, list, or map value selected by type_name.
